feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 6 June 2026 9:25pm
items.description:
##Today##

Outbreaks of rain or drizzle largely clearing away around lunchtime but staying cloudy into the afternoon. Becoming dry late afternoon ahead of further rain later in the evening. Dry overnight into Sunday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

E or SE 20-25, decreasing 15-20 through the morning, becoming variable 5-15 in the afternoon, becoming W or SW 15-20 in the evening, backing S-SW overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Hill fog clearing for a time in the afternoon before returning in the evening.


##Comments##

Strong winds to start.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain, more especially in the afternoon/evening, before clearing overnight into Monday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

23

S

##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Hill fog clearing later.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.
